# verification result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:verificationResult`](gmeow-verificationResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/verificationResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The result of a verification activity applied to an attestation. Non-functional: multiple verification results may coexist from different verifiers or at different times.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:verificationResult`](gmeow-verificationResult.md) from [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) to [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link an attestation to a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) — the outcome perspective, when you care about the verdict (verified, failed, expired) rather than the checking process.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the checking act itself (use [`gmeow:verificationActivity`](gmeow-verificationActivity.md)) and avoid collapsing competing verdicts — results from different verifiers or times coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Point the [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) at each [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md); read the categorical verdict through [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md) and keep every coexisting result rather than overwriting the latest one.

### Examples

- ex:provAtt [`gmeow:verificationResult`](gmeow-verificationResult.md) ex:verifyOutcome.
